notes: Receipts + 'Manage subscription' now identify your account by deployment fingerprint instead of sign-in email — fixes the 'no subscription found for your email' error when the operator email and the buyer email differ
Update banner auto-refreshes on long-open dashboard tabs — no more hard refresh needed to see a new release; a quiet 5-minute poll plus an instant check on tab focus

Setup note: STRIPE_RESTRICTED_KEY needs checkout_sessions:read added (in addition to invoices:read). customers:read is no longer required by the portal — safe to remove if you want to keep the key minimum-scope
